## Why visit

A focused suburban choice for cask, cider and perry rather than grand architecture. The small-premises model lets the beer itself lead: CAMRA describes changing small-brewery ales and cider drawn through wall taps connected to the cellar. This is worth considering if real cider is a central purpose of the trip and you want something outside the usual visitor circuit. It requires a deliberate journey, so confirm opening and the cider range first; with only five days, that call determines whether the detour earns its place.
